title: test_vectors.py: Incorrect fallback produces confusing error on malformed test data
description: Line 183: `doc.get("vectors", doc)` falls back to iterating over the dict itself if "vectors" key is missing. This causes `v["name"]` to raise `TypeError: string indices must be integers` because `v` becomes a dict key string (e.g., "format_version"), not a vector dict. Should use direct access `doc["vectors"]` like other similar functions (lines 128, 135, 153, etc.) for a clear `KeyError` on malformed files.
